Choropleth map of spatial frailties

Source: R/plots.R
plot_choropleth.Rd

Draws a choropleth (filled map) of posterior-mean frailties from a spatial stanSPsurv model. Two back-ends are supported:

plot_choropleth(
  object,
  stage = c("survival", "split"),
  regions = NULL,
  sf_map = NULL,
  sf_key = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  main = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A fitted stanSPsurv object with structure = "spatial".

stage

Which frailty: "survival" (w) or "split" (v).

regions

Character vector of region names for the maps back-end, ordered to match group_levels.

sf_map

An sf object for the sf back-end.

sf_key

Column name in sf_map that matches group_levels.

palette

A vector of colours for the gradient. Default is a blue-white-red diverging palette.

main

Plot title.

...

Additional arguments passed to plot().

Value

Invisible data frame with group, mean frailty, and assigned colour.

Details

  • maps back-end (default): pass regions, a character vector of country or region names matching the maps::world database, in the same order as the spatial units used when fitting.

  • sf back-end: pass sf_map, an sf object with a geometry column and a key column whose values match group_levels.
